model_and_recomputation: Vertical still-air releases from rest over the same ground, fixed body posture and CdA/m, no parachute. Compare maximum and last pre-impact speeds separately. From drag balance sqrt(2g/(rho*k)), g=9.80665, rho=1.225, k=.00505 gives 56.3 m/s = 203 km/h asymptote. ±20% k => 185–227 km/h. These are sea-level limits, not computed landing speeds.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: Actual stratified atmosphere, transonic drag, posture stability, terrain altitude and survivability unresolved. One Stratos fit cannot validate release at 100 km; zero horizontal speed excludes orbital reentry.

model_and_recomputation: Spherical nonrotating airless toy world, density 2,000 kg/m³, radius 3 km. v_c=sqrt(4πGρ/3)*R=2.24 m/s; v_escape=3.17 m/s. Tangential launch at circular speed must begin above the surface with clearance; exact surface circle grazes. A vertical sub-escape jump falls back.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: Phobos is irregular and rotates, Mars perturbs motion. Approximate G*M=7.1e5 m³/s², R=11 km gives v_escape≈11.4 m/s two-body illustration. No real terrain-clearing orbit claim without shape, launch point and trajectory.
readiness: Toy result usable with labels; real trajectory gate.

model_and_recomputation: c=299792.458 km/s. One light-day =25,902,068,371 km; two legs at that range ≈48 h propagation. NASA confirms distance crossing 2026-11-18 10:16:07 UTC; time for an actual command/reply depends on Earth range at transmission/reception, schedules and spacecraft response.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: NASA reported carrier with no science or engineering data on Nov 14. APOD confirmation is distance evidence. Current diagnostic/data recovery state and actual reply capability at release require new mission check. Voyager 2 is distinct.
readiness: Ready for hypothetical/dated transport example only.

model_and_recomputation: Remove lunar forcing in a thought experiment while retaining Sun, Earth spin and current ocean initial state. M_s/M_m*(d_m/d_s)^3 ≈0.46 is solar/lunar differential forcing at mean distances. A pre-existing ocean state evolves and solar forcing remains.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: 0.46 is not a local height fraction. Site geometry, forcing, phase and transient response matter. Harmonic series can illustrate eventual solar components at one station if documented; no literal next-tide or million-year prediction.
readiness: Directional result sound; local numerical transient on hold.

model_and_recomputation: Representative density range 2.7e17 to 1e18 kg/m³ as a model scale, teaspoon 4.93 mL => 1.33e12 to 4.93e12 kg, 1.33–4.93 billion metric tonnes. 0.7 cm³ at 2.7e17 => 1.89e11 kg, 189 million metric tonnes.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: NASA pages provide different indicative analogies. Selected density must be named, and original pressure-held state is assumed. No extraction, stability, holding, impact or explosion outcome validated.
readiness: Hold Long; conditional in-star mass Short only.

countercheck_and_uncertainty: Receding and approaching orbital geometry, reflector site and instrument sensitivity matter. A detectable return is a ranging setup, not an ordinary pointer promise.

model_and_recomputation: Define instantaneous stop of solid surface rotation relative to inertial frame, unchanged orbital motion, free air retaining initial velocity, then prescribed restart after one second. R=6378 km and sidereal day 86164 s => equatorial initial relative speed ≈465 m/s; component scales with cosine of latitude.
countercheck_and_uncertainty: Specify water, buildings, observer coupling and restart impulse. Initial displacement scale is no prediction of wind, wave or global damage. Different choices change payoff.
